target_family_rule: all and only F3B4C2 families with strict_array_plus_recurrent_partner_cluster=True
core_architecture_locus_rule: within each target family, strict ART-geometry locus whose nearest downstream ORF belongs to that family strict-array dominant recurrent partner cluster
A_lineage_rule: exact architecture-core SHA256 plus near-context graph using 31-mer Jaccard >=0.95 and length ratio >=0.95 within family; this is near-context dereplication, not evolutionary lineage proof
A_architecture_core: leftmost strict repeat start through nearest partner ORF stop; 250-bp padding audited separately
B_repeat_rule: all strict arrays from the seven frozen families; motif-core neighborhoods use Levenshtein distance <=1; ART detector thresholds are not changed
C_partner_rule: nearest downstream ORF cluster already frozen by F3B4C; conservation evaluated only within the recurrent strict-array dominant cluster; nearest ORF remains a partner candidate, not confirmed dedicated partner
C_partner_catalog_role: descriptive Pfam/PHROG/VOG annotation if local resources are present
D_structure_rule: all and only target families not previously structure-tested in F3B3E-R1; one architecture-linked representative per family chosen by technical context completeness only
E_known_system_rule: same local frozen known-system reference-panel construction and MMseqs settings as F3B3B; optional user-supplied global FASTA and full ART catalogue are handled separately
final_priority_rule: computational evidence board only: R5C STRONG>SUGGESTIVE>WEAK/NO_HIT>technical unresolved; then recurrent strict-partner accession count; then near-context cluster count; no novelty claim unless E explicitly closes it
claim_boundary: Seven-family post-discovery computational closeout. A/B/C/D/E strengthen architecture, structure and novelty auditing but do not establish biochemical RT activity, dedicated partner function, or Anthropic-unreported novelty by themselves.
